(2) the faithful who visit a cemetery and pray for the dead may gain a plenary indulgence applicable only to the holy souls on the usual conditions once per day from 1st to 8th november. the conditions mentioned above apply also for this. what are indulgences? òindulgences are the remission before god of the temporal punishment due to sins whose guilt has already been forgiven. the faithful christian who is duly disposed gains the indulgence under prescribed conditions for either him/herself or the departed. indulgences are granted through the ministry of the church which, as the dispenser of the grace of redemption, distributes the treasury of the merits of christ and the saintsó (compendium of the catechism of the catholic church, 312). bright
